question: The occupational health department at a hospital implements new safety precautions to prevent laboratory-acquired infections. One of the new precautions includes disinfecting the microbiology laboratory benches with 70% ethanol before and after use. This measure is most likely to be effective in preventing the transmission of which of the following viruses?
analysis: 70% ethanol is effective in inactivating lipid-enveloped viruses like Herpes simplex virus. This virus is most likely to be prevented by disinfecting the laboratory benches with 70% ethanol.
